name: Tsukisa Nazako
source:
Tsukisa is the big brother of hibi, very protective towards these sisters he does not hesitate to have resorted to the violence if necessary.
[spoiler]When Toma saves these sisters, tsukisa recognizes him as part of a family member, and calls him TomTom[/spoiler]
